errors.text_span: синьо за Expert 1, зелено за Expert 3, оранжево за Expert 2 и червено за Expert 4
errors.evidence: The description lists the experts out of the order they appear in the legend (Expert 1, Expert 2, Expert 3, Expert 4), which can cause confusion. The correct color mapping is provided, but the ordering is awkward.

This statement is incorrect for two of the three examples given. At MoE layer index 3 and 5 in the "Text" chart, Expert 3 (green) is the dominant expert, not Expert 1 (blue). Expert 1 is not present in those bars.

errors.text_span: в по-късните слоеве (напр. 15, 17, 19) доминират Expert 3 (зелено) и Expert 2 (оранжево)
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect generalization. At layer index 17, Expert 4 (red) is the dominant expert, not Expert 3 or Expert 2. The statement fails to correctly identify the dominant expert for one of the three examples and misrepresents the pattern.

errors.text_span: Expert 4 (червено) доминира в повечето слоеве, особено в средните и края (напр. 9–23)
errors.evidence: This is a significant misreading of the "Image" chart. While Expert 4 dominates in layers 9-15, it does not dominate in the later layers. Expert 1 dominates at indices 19 and 23, and Expert 2 dominates at indices 17 and 21.

errors.text_span: wobei Expert 1 in den frühen Layern (z. B. Layer 1–5) dominierend ist
errors.evidence: In the "Text" chart, Expert 1 is only dominant in layer 1. In layers 3 and 5, Expert 3 is dominant. The description incorrectly states that Expert 1 is dominant across layers 1-5.
In the "Text" chart, Expert 2 is the dominant expert in layer 7 (approx. 60%) and layer 19 (approx. 80%), which contradicts the claim that its contribution remains mostly below 25%.

errors.text_span: Im Image-Modus ist Expert 4 in den meisten Layern dominant (insbesondere in Layer 1–15)
errors.evidence: While Expert 4 is dominant in many early layers in the "Image" chart, it is not dominant in layer 7, where Expert 3 has the largest share (approx. 75%).

errors.text_span: während Expert 1 in späteren Layern (z. B. 19–23) stark ansteigt und Expert 2 und Expert 3 nur geringe Anteile aufweisen
errors.evidence: In the "Image" chart for layer 21, Expert 2 is the dominant expert with approximately 50% contribution, not a 'geringe Anteile' (small share). Expert 1 is not dominant in this layer.
